title: papyrus stories set-stars: rate a Story from the CLI and MCP like references set-stars
description: From the Anthus news desk editing session 2026-11-08: there is no CLI command to rate a Story. The editor had to call the setItemStars mutation by hand through the CLI's Python client (it works and returned stars 5). Add papyrus stories set-stars --story LINEAGE --stars 1-5|clear (--dry-run, --json), mirroring references set-stars, and a matching MCP tool (one definition behind both), recording who and when. Gherkin: set, change, clear, invalid value, dry run writes nothing, MCP matches CLI.
